gizmo.title: Hoahoa mai i te kuputuhi
gizmo.description: Tuhia he hoahoa hei kuputuhi (Mermaid): he tūtohi rere, he raupapa, he rārangi wā me ētahi atu. Ka tuhia ki te whārangi me tētahi kuputuhi kē.

configure.title: Taitara
configure.description: Ka whakaaturia i runga ake i te hoahoa, ā, ka whakamahia hei ingoa mōna.

configure.title: Pūtake hoahoa
configure.description: Kuputuhi Mermaid, hei tauira: flowchart TD, kātahi kotahi te rārangi mō ia hono pērā i A[Draft] --> B{Ready?}. Tāpirihia te |label| i muri i tētahi pere hei tapanga. Ka whakahoutia te tuhinga i a koe e patopato ana.

configure.title: Kuputuhi kē
configure.description: Whakaahuatia te mea e whakaaturia ana e te hoahoa mō te hunga kāore e kite. Waiho kia wātea i tētahi tūtohi rere kia whakarārangitia ōna hipanga mōu.

configure.title: Tapanga
configure.description: He tapanga kōwhiri ka whakaaturia i raro i te hoahoa.

configure.title: Whakaatu i te pūtake
configure.description: Whakaaturia te kuputuhi hoahoa i te taha o te tuhinga.

configure.title: Whakaatu i te kuputuhi kē
configure.description: Whakaaturia te kuputuhi kē i raro i te tuhinga. E wātea ana i ngā wā katoa ki ngā kaipānui mata.

advanced.title: Kōnae pūtake
advanced.description: Te wāhitau o tētahi kōnae .mmd hei tuhi hei whakakapi i te kuputuhi i runga ake (https, he ara rānei i tēnei pae).

advanced.title: Tae arotahi
advanced.description: Te tae o te maramara ata i te pane.
